label: A respected Hawaiian man rises with great influence over the islands
description: A heavy-set Hawaiian man, very respected among Hawaiian people, whom the Lord says he is bringing forward to have great influence on the Hawaiian Islands, with the emphasis on culture. He says he knows nothing of Hawaiian culture. Nobody is named, so the match would have to be a figure of that description rising to prominence.

label: Cowards in political office are squandering the window given to America
description: The Lord using the word coward for people in political positions who will not stand for what is right and are squandering a window given to buy America more time and a better foundation before the storm, so that only a little more time is left and it is on a wire. Nobody is named and the window is not dated, which leaves nothing to score except the storm itself.

label: A SeaWorld with roller coasters and Ford dealerships in Cuba
description: A new marine park in Cuba with killer whales and blue roller coasters, called something like Southern Caribbean, with amusement rides, beachfront hotels and new construction, and the American car industry arriving with Ford in large letters selling trucks, cars and SUVs. Both would require the embargo to be lifted and named American corporations to enter, which makes this unusually checkable.

label: Ireland saved and on fire, its whole population in revival
description: Ireland called saved and set on fire for Jesus, with the whole population, which he gives as five and a half or seven million, coming into a major revival, one of the small forgotten places the Lord is calling in. He confuses the Cuban and Irish population figures on air. Irish religious observance has fallen steadily for thirty years, which is the base rate this would have to reverse.
